title: Dr. Jim Schultz Shows How to Trade Earnings Season as a Premium Seller
speaker: Jim Schultz

macro_themes.view: Earnings outcomes are essentially a coin flip with a slight upside drift; trade them with defined risk, smaller size (half to a third of normal), entered near the close before the report.

notes: Educational options show with no stated market views. Alcoa (AA) bullish put spread and Netflix (NFLX) upside expected-move butterfly (buy 73 / sell 2x 79 / buy 85) were illustrative examples only ('just flip a coin, man'), so not recorded as calls. video_type set to daily_market as the closest fit for an education segment.
